summary: mail-redelivery-canaries can be signed locally: scripts/ci-local runs a scripts/ci-linux stage as its CI job does, in a scratch home with no st, GitHub or SSH agent variable; st-test runs it when named or with --all (a heavy check, never on the pre-push hook's default run); the lane and the host and agent levels (lane-bound, pull requests only) admit its notes.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: A new lane entry and by_level entries in existing files; no new keys.

rules.detail: A host- or agent-signed note for mail-redelivery-canaries now counts on pull requests when it was signed against the base's lane definition; the check stays in shadow (enforce false) until its own flip. The merge queue runs the stage as before.

compatibility.detail: st-test's default selection is unchanged; the new check runs only when asked for.

manual.detail: None: a host signs it with its existing key (scripts/st-test --check mail-redelivery-canaries --push origin).

recovery.detail: Remove the by_level entries; nothing else depends on them.
